description:
The NotepadApp project is open in Android Studio. The project compiles without errors, but the app crashes immediately on launch. A colleague reports the following from logcat:

  'FATAL EXCEPTION: main — java.lang.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: lateinit property formatter has not been initialized'

However, this may not be the only issue. There appear to be multiple runtime bugs in the codebase that cause crashes during normal operation. Investigate the source code, identify ALL runtime issues, and fix them so the app runs correctly.

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

After fixing all issues, verify the project still compiles.
